FN-HGVIG38-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 411
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Craig Lipscomb
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/13/2026
House Bill 411 as introduced would decrease sales tax receipts to the following funds by the
following estimated amounts annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, by exempting the
Auxiliary of Big Oak Ranch, Incorporated, from paying or collecting state, county, and
municipal sales and use taxes:
Education Trust Fund $1,510
County Funds $760
Municipal Funds $1,130
Total $3,400
Page 1

FN-HGVIG38-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 411
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Craig Lipscomb
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/18/2026
House Bill 411 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education would decrease
sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an estimated $1,510 annually, beginning in
Fiscal Year 2027, by exempting the Auxiliary of Big Oak Ranch, Incorporated, from paying or
collecting state sales and use taxes.
This bill could also decrease receipts to the following funds by the following estimated annual
amounts, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, if the respective local governments adopt an exemption
from local sales and use taxes, pursuant to this bill:
County Funds $760
Municipal Funds $1,130
Total $1,890
Page 1
